text:
noah: FYI ran into a weird visual bug on a 320px viewport when the sidebar is in overlay mode. The footer CTA overlaps the bottom row of the table and the sticky header briefly flashes when opening the sidebar.
ellen: Oof. Which footer CTA? The new "Create deployment" sticky?
noah: Yep that one. When sidebar slides in it shifts layout then the header jumps. Seems like a repaint issue.
pat: Can you repro with `prefers-reduced-motion`? The slide animation might be causing reflow.
noah: With reduced motion the problem is less pronounced but the overlap still happens if table has dense rows.
jin: Screenshot + repro steps would help. Also what browser/device?
noah: iPhone 8 Safari iOS 13 (emulated in BrowserStack). Steps: 1) load /deployments on narrow width 2) collapse sidebar to overlay mode 3) tap site nav to open sidebar 4) observe header flash and footer overlap. Link: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/footer-overlap-320.png
elllen: (typo) ellen: Looks like the footer uses `position: sticky; bottom: 0;` and the table wrapper also uses `transform: translateZ(0)` for GPU compositing. When overlay opens we change `overflow` on body which can break stacking context.
pat: That matches. If the sidebar sets `will-change: transform` it could create a new stacking context that pushes the sticky out of its containing block. Quick fix: make the footer be a top-level sibling with `z-index` above sidebar and set `contain: paint` on the table container.
jin: Also consider avoiding body overflow toggles that set `position: fixed` on the root — that changes viewport height calculations on mobile Safari causing layout jumps. Instead use `touch-action` lock or an inert overlay.
noah: Proposed patch: ```css
/* make footer independent of table stacking context */
.app-footer { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 9000; }
.table-wrapper { contain: layout; }
.sidebar-overlay { will-change: transform; transform: translateZ(0); }
```
elllen: That might work but fixed footer has accessibility pitfalls (SR focus). We need to ensure it doesn't trap keyboard focus and is dismissible from keyboard.
pat: Add `aria-hidden` rules and ensure the footer's primary action is reachable via `tabindex=0` order logic. Also verify VoiceOver focus after opening/closing sidebar.
jin: Performance check: avoid heavy `contain` usages across many rows — test on lower-end Android. Maybe only apply `contain: layout` on the visible table viewport (virtualized container).
noah: UX question: should the overlay sidebar push the table up (reduce visible rows) or slide over content? Which is better on small screens?
elllen: For discoverability slide over is better; users expect nav to overlay. But push behavior avoids overlap with sticky elements. Tradeoffs.
pat: If overlay is preferred we must ensure it doesn't change page height calculation. Use `position: fixed` for sidebar and avoid toggling `overflow: hidden` on body.
noah: Good. Copy tweak: the sticky CTA currently says "Create". On small screens it gets truncated to "Crea". Can we prefer the short label "New deployment" vs icon+label?
jin: On tiny widths icon + `sr-only` text could save space. Or use a two-variant label: full "Create deployment" above 360px, and icon+tooltip under 360px. Add telemetry `ui.footer.create_variant` for A/B.
elllen: Prefer explicit words for accessibility. If using icon-only, add `aria-label="Create deployment"` and visible tooltip on long-press. Also ensure the hit target is >=44px.
pat: QA checklist I'll add: iPhone 8 Safari, Pixel 3a Chrome, Android webview, VoiceOver (iOS) + TalkBack. Test with large fonts and RTL.
ux-bot: Link created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/2937 - "mobile sticky footer overlap with overlay sidebar". Suggested assignees: @ellen @pat.
noah: Thanks all. I'll try the CSS changes and open a small canary behind `mobile_footer_fix` flag. Will include telemetry for copy variant and a tiny perf marker around sidebar open/close.
ellen: Sweet. If you push a draft PR tag me and I'll run the accessibility pass. :sparkles:
